title: AI 客服 — 成本 / 效能 / 品質
description: 資料來源：後端 message 表的 trace 欄位。所有查詢都帶 message_type=1（一個請求會被寫成兩列，不去重會重複計算）與 CAST（JSON_EXTRACT 不轉型會變字串比較，數字會錯）。 ⚠️ created_at 有 +8 小時偏移（後端把本地時間寫進 UTC 的 TIMESTAMP 欄位），全部查詢用 ${tzfix} 變數補償，後端修好後設為 0。

list.name: tzfix
list.label: 時區補償(小時)
list.description: 後端把台北時間(+8)寫進 UTC 連線的 TIMESTAMP 欄位，資料在絕對時間上超前 8 小時。所有時間比較都減掉這個值來補償。後端修正資料後改成 0 即可。

panels.title: 請求數
panels.description: 已排除 message_type=2 的重複列

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS `請求數` FROM message WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at - INTERVAL ${tzfix} HOUR) AND message_type = 1 AND JSON_VALID(trace) AND JSON_EXTRACT(trace,'$.usage') IS NOT NULL

panels.title: 總成本
panels.description: 依 langchain 內建價目表估算，未收錄的新模型會算成 0 —— 看趨勢，別拿去對帳單

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CAST(JSON_EXTRACT(trace,'$.usage.cost_usd') AS DECIMAL(12,6))),4) AS `成本` FROM message WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at - INTERVAL ${tzfix} HOUR) AND message_type = 1 AND JSON_VALID(trace) AND JSON_EXTRACT(trace,'$.usage') IS NOT NULL

panels.title: 平均回應時間
panels.description: 伺服器端端到端，不含後端推播給客人的時間

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST(JSON_EXTRACT(trace,'$.elapsed_ms') AS UNSIGNED))/1000,2) AS `秒` FROM message WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at - INTERVAL ${tzfix} HOUR) AND message_type = 1 AND JSON_VALID(trace) AND JSON_EXTRACT(trace,'$.usage') IS NOT NULL

panels.title: 轉真人率
panels.description: handoff_reason 非 null 的比例。MariaDB 的 JSON null 經 JSON_UNQUOTE 會變成字串 'null'，所以用 NOT IN ('null') 判斷

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(100*AVG(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(trace,'$.handoff_reason')) NOT IN ('null')),1) AS `轉真人率` FROM message WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at - INTERVAL ${tzfix} HOUR) AND message_type = 1 AND JSON_VALID(trace) AND JSON_EXTRACT(trace,'$.usage') IS NOT NULL

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at - INTERVAL ${tzfix} HOUR,$__interval), COUNT(*) AS `請求數`, ROUND(SUM(CAST(JSON_EXTRACT(trace,'$.usage.cost_usd') AS DECIMAL(12,6))),4) AS `成本USD` FROM message WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at - INTERVAL ${tzfix} HOUR) AND message_type = 1 AND JSON_VALID(trace) AND JSON_EXTRACT(trace,'$.usage') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 回應時間（平均 / 最慢）
panels.description: 最慢那條用來檢查 LLM_TIMEOUT 設定是否合理 —— 若貼近 60s×呼叫次數就該調整

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at - INTERVAL ${tzfix} HOUR,$__interval), ROUND(AVG(CAST(JSON_EXTRACT(trace,'$.elapsed_ms') AS UNSIGNED))) AS `平均`, MAX(CAST(JSON_EXTRACT(trace,'$.elapsed_ms') AS UNSIGNED)) AS `最慢` FROM message WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at - INTERVAL ${tzfix} HOUR) AND message_type = 1 AND JSON_VALID(trace) AND JSON_EXTRACT(trace,'$.usage') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: token 組成（input vs output）
panels.description: 成本幾乎全在 input。實測 input 佔 97%，且主要由『一輪打幾次 LLM × 各自的大 system prompt』決定，不是檢索量

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at - INTERVAL ${tzfix} HOUR,$__interval), SUM(CAST(JSON_EXTRACT(trace,'$.usage.prompt_tokens') AS UNSIGNED)) AS `input`, SUM(CAST(JSON_EXTRACT(trace,'$.usage.completion_tokens') AS UNSIGNED)) AS `output` FROM message WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at - INTERVAL ${tzfix} HOUR) AND message_type = 1 AND JSON_VALID(trace) AND JSON_EXTRACT(trace,'$.usage') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 路由分布 / 轉真人原因
panels.description: route = supervisor 把請求分給誰；handoff_reason 為 null 代表正常完成

targets.rawSql: SELECT CONCAT(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(trace,'$.route')),' / ',JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(trace,'$.handoff_reason'))) AS `分類`, COUNT(*) AS `筆數` FROM message WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at - INTERVAL ${tzfix} HOUR) AND message_type = 1 AND JSON_VALID(trace) AND JSON_EXTRACT(trace,'$.usage') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: 最貴的 20 筆（含檢索量對照）
panels.description: 檢索字數高 → 該調 retriever 的 k；LLM次數高 → 該看 booking 的 tool 迴圈。⚠️ 這張表會顯示客人原話

targets.rawSql: SELECT created_at - INTERVAL ${tzfix} HOUR AS `時間`, LEFT(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(trace,'$.user_input')),40) AS `客人問題`, CAST(JSON_EXTRACT(trace,'$.usage.total_tokens') AS UNSIGNED) AS `tokens`, CAST(JSON_EXTRACT(trace,'$.usage.llm_calls') AS UNSIGNED) AS `LLM次數`, CAST(JSON_EXTRACT(trace,'$.grounding_chars') AS UNSIGNED) AS `檢索字數`, CAST(JSON_EXTRACT(trace,'$.elapsed_ms') AS UNSIGNED) AS `耗時`, CAST(JSON_EXTRACT(trace,'$.usage.cost_usd') AS DECIMAL(12,6)) AS `成本`, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(trace,'$.route')) AS `路由` FROM message WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at - INTERVAL ${tzfix} HOUR) AND message_type = 1 AND JSON_VALID(trace) AND JSON_EXTRACT(trace,'$.usage') IS NOT NULL ORDER BY tokens DESC LIMIT 20
